items.author: doctoboggan
items.descZh: 这是一款部署在 Bluesky 社交平台上的自动化机器人（账号 @hnwiki.bsky.social），由开发者 @jackm.in 创建。其核心功能是从 HackerNews 论坛中筛选出带有维基百科链接的帖子，并将对应的维基百科文章内容自动转发到 Bluesky。该机器人充当了两个知识社区之间的桥梁，让用户无需跳转即可在 Bluesky 上浏览 HackerNews 讨论的百科主题。亮点在于其内容聚合的自动化机制——例如本次推送涉及 1939 年发现的史前雕刻"狮人"（Lionman/Löwenmensch），并附带了 HackerNews 原帖和维基百科的双向链接，方便追溯讨论出处和深度阅读。适用场景主要面向喜欢在社交平台获取冷知识、对百科类内容感兴趣的读者，以及希望跨平台追踪 HackerNews 知识类讨论的用户。

items.author: EmiCorleone
items.descZh: Compute Cheap 是一个面向 AI 训练与推理场景的低价 GPU 算力市场，主打 NVIDIA H100 与 H200 两款旗舰级加速卡。其核心功能是聚合多家算力供应商的空闲 H100/H200 容量，以竞价方式为用户提供按需（Ondemand）或竞价实例（Spot）服务，从而压低 GPU 小时单价。该平台的亮点在于价格极具竞争力：H100 80GB 按需价仅 $1.931/GPU·小时，Spot 价低至 $1.246/小时；H200 141GB HBM3e 按需价 $2.917/小时，Spot 价 $1.855/小时，相比主流云厂商通常的 2–4 美元以上水平有明显优势。它采用"用多少付多少"模式，无长约、无闲置账单，并通过精简技术栈省去企业级管理服务带来的额外成本。最适合的应用场景是需要大规模 H100/H200 进行大模型训练、推理以及短期或弹性算力需求的 AI 研究团队与初创公司，以最低成本获得前沿 GPU 资源。
items.quote: Compute Cheap -世界上最便宜的GPU计算。

items.title: Show HN: Kagelin – offline-first tasks/habits/focus/calendar, AGPL
items.desc: description: The productivity app that doesn&x27;t fight for your attention. Tasks, focus, habits, and calendar in one calm, offlinefirst space — no streaks, no badges, no dopamine bait. Free and open source. title: Kagelin — Work quietly. Own everything. image: https://kagelin.app/opengraphimage?91965274137c90f4 Work quietly. Own everything. The productivity app that doesn’t fight for your attention. Tasks, focus, habits, and a calendar in one calm space that works offline. Nothing here is built to hook you or guilt you into coming back. Just your work, without the noise. The waitlist reopens soon. Come back at 25 Aug 2026, 11:00 am to join. Board view [](/screenshots/boardviewdesktop.webp) No dopamine bait No confetti, no dark patterns, no notifications engineered to pull you back. Streaks are there if you want them, never used to guilt you into showing up. Offlinefirst Everything works with no connection and no account. Guest mode keeps your data on your device, and you only sync if you want to. Free & open (AGPL) Run it in guest mode or host it yourself, no account needed. The core app is free and open source under AGPL3.0\. Premium is optional, just for the hosted extras. Calendar [](/screenshots/calendarmonthly.webp) A real calendar with Google and Outlook sync, not a todo list with dates bolted on. Focus timer [](/screenshots/timerwithtask.webp) A quiet Pomodoro timer that stays with you in PictureinPicture while you work. Habits [](/screenshots/habitgriddesktop.webp) Track habits without the guilt. Streaks and a calm grid you can glance at, not a scoreboard. Command palette [](/screenshots/commandpalletedesktop.webp) Press Ctrl or CmdK to jump to any task, habit, event, or action. No hunting through menus. Show 2 more screenshots Also·recurring tasks··.ics import and export··full keyboard control··installable PWA··encrypted export Founding testers Help shape it early. A small group of founding testers gets in before everything is polished. If you actually use it and tell us what breaks, you get a year of Premium free, plus a founding discount that stays as long as you do. It’s a thankyou for showing up early, not a countdown timer. Premium only covers the hosted extras like background calendar sync, focus across devices, and push briefings. The app itself stays free. The waitlist reopens soon. Come back at 25 Aug 2026, 11:00 am to join. How Kagelin sustains itself Kagelin is free and open source, and the app stays that way. The part that costs real money to run is the hosted layer: background calendar sync, focus across devices, push briefings. Premium is an optional subscription that covers those, and it’s what pays for development. If you selfhost or use guest mode, you never touch it. You can also support the project directly. [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Achyuth072)[Kofi](https://kofi.com/oneakira) Questions Is it free? Yes, to use. Every task, habit, focus, and calendar feature is free and needs no account. The app is open source under AGPL3.0\. Premium is an optional paid tier that only covers the hosted sync extras. Do I need an account? No. Guest mode is not inviteonly and can be used anytime. It gives you everything offline, with your data kept on your device. You only make an account if you want to sync across devices. When does it launch? It is in preview now, opening to founding testers first. Guest mode can be used anytime, and you can join the list for cloud sync invites. Is my data private? Your data is yours. items.author: achyuth072
items.descZh: Kagelin 是一款主打"反成瘾设计"的生产力工具，将任务、专注计时器、习惯追踪和日历整合在同一离线优先界面中，通过移除徽章、连击计数等"多巴胺诱饵"来对抗当下生产力应用常见的注意力争夺策略。产品亮点包括支持 Google/Outlook 同步的真实日历、可在画中画模式跟随工作的静音番茄钟、用于快速导航的 Ctrl/Cmd+K 命令面板，以及基于 AGPL-3.0 协议的完整开源和自托管支持，数据默认存储在本地设备，可选 WebDAV 同步并支持加密导出。该项目采用免费核心 + 可选 Premium 订阅的商业模式，后者仅覆盖后台日历同步、跨设备专注状态和推送简报等托管层功能，开发资金来源于订阅收入和 GitHub Sponsors/Ko-fi 直接赞助。目前产品处于预览阶段，将于 2026 年 8 月 25 日重新开放候补名单，早期"创始测试者"可获得一年免费 Premium 换取真实使用反馈。适用人群为注重数据主权、厌恶社交化压力机制、偏好 PWA/本地优先工作流的知识工作者、独立开发者和开源爱好者。
items.quote: 这里的一切都不是为了吸引你或让你产生愧疚感而设计的。只有你的工作，没有干扰。

items.descZh: Clippy Vision 是 protocorn 在 GitHub 上发布的早期测试项目(仓库 Star 12、Fork 11),旨在解决用户在不同应用间切换时"上下文丢失"的痛点,通过持续捕获屏幕内容来保留工作记忆。开发者于 2026 年 9 月 1 日发起 Issue #53,向已试用用户征集反馈,问卷约 5 分钟,重点关注四个方向:跨应用上下文丢失是否真实存在、是否愿意全天运行、对截取内容的可控性,以及 MCP 集成、捕获审计视图、隐私脱敏等路线图优先级。文章明确指出敏感应用自动脱敏功能仍在开发中,目前最可靠的隐私手段是手动暂停捕获,体现了产品对用户隐私的审慎态度。该阶段属于典型早期采用者(early adopter)反馈收集环节,功能尚未完整,适合愿意尝鲜并提供使用体验的开发者与重度多任务办公人群。
items.quote: 对敏感应用的自动遮罩功能仍在开发中。目前最可靠的隐私保护方式是暂停录制。

items.desc: description: reachpad router is a cloud VM API: ask for CPU, RAM, disk and a region, and it provisions the machine that fits at the best price across providers, billed per second at raw cost. Give your agent the skill.md, or build the create call field by field. title: reachpad router image: https://reachpad.dev/router/opengraphimage?3f6f80f599560123 Ask for CPU, RAM and a region. Get a cloud VM. Routing finds the machine that fits your ask at the best price across providers. The meter runs per second at raw provider cost, and the machine dies on your TTL, your budget, or a DELETE. give this to your agent set up https://reachpad.dev/router/skill.mdcopy The skill covers keys, paying, provisioning, exec and teardown. An agent with a funded key takes it from there. [Build your own machine](build)[Read the docs](/router/docs) Build every call Everything lives under https://router.reachpad.dev/v1 and answers JSON. Open an endpoint, pick its values, copy the call. Payment is USDC over x402, with one 5% fee at topup; machines spend at raw provider cost, metered per second, until ttl_seconds, max_spend, or a DELETE ends them. POST/v1/machinesCreate a machine: the shape, the region, the access, the limits. cpu 1248 ram_gb 124816 disk_gb 8204080 region uswestuseasteucentral access sshexecssh + exec ssh is a key login and a hostname; exec runs one command over HTTP, with neither. ssh_public_key sshed25519 AAAA... you@host A placeholder. Paste your own key before running. ttl_seconds 15 min1 hour4 hours24 hours Destroys the machine at expiry; default 4 hours. Some offers cap TTL, so shorter routes to more of them. max_spend omit$0.50$1.50$5.00 Destroys the machine when accrued spend reaches it. Offers that cannot run 5 minutes inside it never route. max\_rate and client\_ref max_rate omit$0.05$0.15$0.50 Drops offers whose hourly rate is above it. client_ref A retried create carrying the same ref returns the machine it already made instead of buying a second one. POST /v1/machinescopy $KEY is your API key: POST /v1/accounts mints one$ curl sS X POST https://router.reachpad.dev/v1/machines \ H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" H "ContentType: application/json" \ d '{"cpu":2,"ram_gb":4,"disk_gb":8, "region":"uswest","access":["ssh"], "ssh_public_key":"sshed25519 AAAA... you@host", "ttl_seconds":3600,"max_spend":"1.50"}' GET/v1/machines/:idOne machine: state, host, runtime and live accrued spend. :id GET /v1/machines/:idcopy $ curl sS https://router.reachpad.dev/v1/machines/rp_vm_abc123def4 \ H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" GET/v1/machinesEvery machine, newest first, destroyed ones included. No request fields. GET /v1/machinescopy $ curl sS https://router.reachpad.dev/v1/machines \ H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" DELETE/v1/machines/:idDestroy it. The response carries the final charge. :id Idempotent: a second DELETE returns the same final charge. DELETE /v1/machines/:idcopy $ curl sS X DELETE https://router.reachpad.dev/v1/machines/rp_vm_abc123def4 \ H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" POST/v1/machines/:id/execRun one shell command; output, exit code and wall time come back. :id cmd A shell string; stdout and stderr come back combined. timeout_s omit60600 Default 300, max 600\. The process is killed at expiry. POST /v1/machines/:id/execcopy $ curl sS X POST https://router.reachpad.dev/v1/machines/rp_vm_abc123def4/exec \ H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" H "ContentType: application/json" \ d '{"cmd":"uname a"}' POST/v1/machines/:id/portsExpose an HTTP port and get the provider’s own bridge URL. DELETE unexposes it. :id port 3000517380008080 HTTP and WebSocket only; the response carries the provider's own bridge URL. POST /v1/machines/:id/portscopy $ curl sS X POST https://router.reachpad.dev/v1/machines/rp_vm_abc123def4/ports \ H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" H "ContentType: application/json" \ d '{"port":3000}' POST/v1/accountsMint an account and its API key, shown once. No request fields and no key: this is where a key comes from. POST /v1/accountscopy $ curl sS X POST https://router.reachpad.dev/v1/accounts {"id":"cus_...","api_key":"rp_key_..."} shown once; store it GET/v1/creditsBalance, every deposit, every charge. No request fields. GET /v1/creditscopy $ curl sS https://router.reachpad.dev/v1/credits \ H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" POST/v1/credits/topupsAdd credits with USDC over x402: the 402 names the amount. amount $5.00$25.00$100.00 USDC over x402, $1.00 minimum. The 402 carries the payment block; retry the same request with a PAYMENTSIGNATURE header to settle. POST /v1/credits/topupscopy $ curl sS X POST https://router.reachpad.dev/v1/credits/topups \ H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" H "ContentType: application/json" \ d '{"method":"usdc","amount":"25.00"}' 402: the x402 payment block for that amount GETPOST/v1/credits/recoveryReissue a wallet account’s key from a signed message. wallet Wallet accounts only: a key minted at /v1/accounts has no wallet and no recovery path. GET, POST /v1/credits/recoverycopy $ curl sS "https://router.reachpad.dev/v1/credits/recovery?wallet=0xYourWallet" a challenge message to sign with the wallet$ curl sS X POST https://router.reachpad.dev/v1/credits/recovery \ H "ContentType: application/json" \ d '{"wallet":"0xYourWallet","message":"<the message verbatim","signature":"0x..."}' Make the first call. Hand the skill to your agent, or read the reference and run the curl yourself. set up https://reachpad.dev/router/skill.mdcopy [Read the docs](/router/docs) [Log in](/signin)[Start free](/signup) json {"@context":"https://schema.org","@graph":[{"@type":"Organization","@id":"https://reachpad.dev/organization","name":"reachpad","url":"https://reachpad.dev","logo":"https://reachpad.dev/icon.png","description":"reachpad lets Claude, Codex and other coding agents build fullstack apps in persistent workspaces and share them by link, without a separate deployment.","email":"hello@reachpad.dev","sameAs":["https://x.com/reachpad","https://www.linkedin.com/company/reachpad"]},{"@type":"WebSit
items.author: sakuraiben
items.descZh: reachpad router 是一个面向 AI 编程代理的云虚拟机调度 API,用户只需声明 CPU、内存、磁盘和区域,系统自动在多家云服务商之间找到最低价的匹配机器,按秒计费,费用等同于云商原始成本。计费基于 USDC 通过 x402 协议结算,充值时收取一次性 5% 手续费,VM 可通过 TTL、max_spend 或 DELETE 三种方式终止,且 DELETE 操作幂等。机器支持 SSH 接入和 HTTP exec 远程执行(超时最长 600 秒),还可通过端口暴露获得服务商直连的 bridge URL,适合 agent 在隔离沙箱中运行命令并产出可访问的 Web 服务。支付层引入钱包账户的签名恢复机制,API 密钥仅在创建时返回一次,兼顾安全与可恢复性。该服务特别适合需要让 Claude、Codex 等 coding agent 自主获取短生命周期、按需付费计算资源的场景,例如自动化代码执行、临时环境测试或代理驱动的全栈应用构建,既可通过 skill.md 一键交给 agent,也可手动构造 curl 请求逐步调试。
items.quote: 路由会在各提供商中找到最匹配你需求且价格最优的机器。按秒计费，费率按提供商原始成本计算，机器在达到你的 TT（容忍时长）时终止。

items.author: rohangnaneshjh
items.descZh: GIDE（GenerativeIDE）是一款主打隐私优先、模型无关的 AI 代码编辑器，将"本地运行"与"云端 API 接入"两条路径整合在同一界面内，核心卖点是可在完全离线的环境下使用本地大模型且零 token 费用，同时支持用户接入自有 API key。其内置的默认模型 Ornith 9B 随安装即用，声称在 Windows 上只需 12 GB VRAM、Mac 上 18 GB 统一内存即可运行，无需 Ollama、Python 环境或 CUDA 工具链，上下文窗口在 18 GB 机器上为 32K，更高内存配置可扩展到 48–64K。文章重点演示了它在真实会话中的工作方式：先对仓库做语义检索与文件阅读，再由"plan gate + write gate"双重审批机制把关，最终以 diff 形式向用户提出修改建议，每一次文件写入与 shell 命令都必须经用户显式接受或拒绝，被拒绝的指令还会反馈给模型促使其重试。文中给出的一组具体数字颇具说服力：本地推理零 token 成本、无速率限制、断网仍可工作，且每次决策都被记录在本地 JSONL 审计日志中，编辑器、CLI 与 CI 三端共用同一套审批闸门。它同时提供 CLI 版本，可在 macOS、Linux 与 Windows 上离线运行、返回真实退出码，并对外暴露 OpenAI 兼容的本地端点，便于用户用自有工具调用本地模型。该产品适合需要在严格数据隔离环境下写代码的个人或团队，也适合希望把本地 LLM 作为开发流水线一环集成进 CI 或脚本的工程师；30 天试用无需信用卡即可下载体验。

items.descZh: 这是一个面向营销与增长团队的竞品文案情报库，收录了 118 个实时产品网站（覆盖 20 个类别）的首屏标题（Hero Headline）与副标题（Subheadline），并附截图与版本历史，每周边刷新一次以追踪对手的定位迭代。其核心功能是按行业（如 AI Cloud、Security、Browser Infra、Agent Eval 等）浏览各产品的原文案与改版记录，并通过搜索快速定位特定产品的定位策略，例如 Akash 强调"以极低成本调用全球 GPU 算力"，Akeyless 主打"已保障 220B+ 次机器交互的安全规模"，Apify 则亮出"65,824 个 AI 可用工具"的具体数字。亮点在于把"标题赢得第二行、副标题赢得滚动"这一转化理念产品化，提供可检索、可对比、可回溯的竞品文案语料库，并明确标注每个产品的最近更新时间（多为 2026 年 8 月底）。最适用场景是产品营销经理在重写自家首屏文案前，快速对标同类产品的定位话术与演变路径，亦适合增长黑客与品牌策略人员追踪赛道风向。
items.quote: 标题赢得第二行。副标题赢得滚动。
